command: set -euo pipefail; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null; echo NODE=$(node -v); echo NPM=$(npm -v); echo WS=$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(typeof WebSocket)'); set +e; timeout 25s npx -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote; rc=$?; set -e; echo REMOTE_RC=$rc
